rejected_attempts.opinion: Matte coral paint, plum contours, separate side thumb and shell cuff fit the illustrated world. Three vertically separated finger-like knuckle lobes make it read too much as a padded bare fist rather than one protective boxing mitten. Require a single smooth continuous padded knuckle dome before mounted review. Preserve rejected original unchanged.
